data.one_liner: Dart library for converting between different units of measurement for various quantities
data.what_it_does: A library for converting measurements across quantities such as length, mass, time, temperature, area, volume, and more. It allows operations like addition, subtraction, and comparisons between units.
use_when: You need to convert measurements between different units in Dart or Flutter
You need to perform mathematical operations and comparisons on quantities with different units
avoid_when: You require a non-Dart implementation or a different feature set not covered by the library
strengths: Supports a wide range of quantities and units including SI units
Provides arithmetic operations and comparisons between different units of the same quantity
weaknesses: Limited to the specific quantities and units defined by the package
